germs.title: Germs
germs.text: Germs are very small. We can’t see them. They are on desks, doors and pencils. Some germs make us sick, so we should wash our hands.

nurse.title: At the school nurse
nurse.text: Leo falls in the playground. His knee hurts. The school nurse puts a bandage on it. She says, “You shouldn’t run today.”

water.title: A new tap
water.text: The village has a new well. A solar panel gives power to the pump. The children don’t carry heavy bottles now. They get clean water from the tap.

lines.text: Mia makes a card for Sam.

rd-p1.title: Mia’s Cold
rd-p1.text: On Monday, Mia wakes up with a cold. She is sneezing and her throat hurts. Dad takes her temperature. “You should stay in bed,” he says. Mia rests and drinks water. On Wednesday, she feels better!

rd-p2.title: Clean Water
rd-p2.text: In some villages, children walk to a river. They fill big bottles and carry them home. The bottles are heavy. River water is not always clean. Now the village has a well. Clean water comes out of a tap!

rd-p3.title: Tiny Germs
rd-p3.text: Germs are very small. We can’t see them, but they are everywhere. They are on doors, desks and pencils. Some germs make us sick. We should wash our hands before we eat and cover our mouth when we cough.

rd-p4.title: Leo’s Week
rd-p4.text: Leo always brushes his teeth in the morning and at night. He usually takes a shower after football. He sometimes uses hand gel at school. He cuts his nails once a week. He never eats with dirty hands!
